sketch:
Observe: SVG scene of a ball on a table with 3 candidate "actions"
shown as labelled arrows (contact avec la table, poids, action d'une
main). Student toggles each action on/off and drags its point of
application; a summary panel classifies each as contact/distance,
localisée/répartie. Advance after each action inspected. Experiment:
3 seeded scenes (livre sur étagère, aimant, ressort tiré); student
identifies which arrows belong on each. Evaluate: arrows hidden;
student places arrows at correct application points from scratch.
Wrinkle: 1ère — no vector algebra, just inventaire des actions.
